'''Rockfu''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Punchimp]] at 6 bronze stars, and into [[Rockwu]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Rockfu snapped a branch off some tree and learned to bring a decoy clone along when poking hornets nests. If the hornets give chase, that clone is not coming home."

Rockfu is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A brown chimpanzee with a light brown face and underbelly, and an orange mask-like marking around its eyes. It also has brown pupils and it wields a stone club.

Rockfu's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces brown with blue.

==Evolution Trial==
Rockfu's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Rockwu]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Rockfu to increase stats 3 times.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 5,000 energy drinks.

== Trivia ==
* Original Bio: "Once a [[Punchimp]] finds its very own whacking stick, it naturally evolves into Rockfu."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Picking up sticks is wired into primate DNA---even humans do it. Pre-apocalypse, people shared stick pics on the internet."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Iron staff always in hand, Rockfu swings at anything in sight, often causing unnecessary trouble for the trainer."

==Strategy==
[[File:Rockfu Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Rockfu's attack range]]
Rockfu's attack range is deceptively long- despite it showing in game as a single space ahead of it, it can reach up to 4 tiles ahead with it's clone. Additionally, this Tatari can hit behind itself- proving useful in the [[Boss Challenge|Road Bully Boss Challenge]], since if Road Bully hits it out of the way, it can continue attacking.
